comment: Domain-specific defect checklists consumed by the generic 'review' mode. Every rules[] entry is validated against the built index, so a checklist cannot cite an ID that does not exist.

items.defect: P&L computed after the position resize, so today's fill earns today's move
No cost model, or costs bolted on after the fact
Full-sample statistics used to build labels or regime thresholds
Optimised parameters with no out-of-sample confirmation
Variance-driven allocation across strategies of mixed skew
Stop losses applied to a mean-reversion strategy whose premise is overshoot
Sharpe annualised without adjusting for serial dependence
Trials counted nominally rather than effectively
Max drawdown read as a standalone quality measure
Equal weighting with no risk-contribution check
Borrow, locate or short-sale restriction ignored on the short side
Survivorship bias asserted as disqualifying without checking which way it runs
